explanation_en: This verbal phrase means 'to let something slide' or 'to overlook'. It is used when a person or institution decides not to react to a provocation, mistake, or insult, choosing to ignore it instead.

examples.en_text: The boss saw my mistake in the report, but he let it slide because it was the first time.
examples.target_text: O chefe viu o meu erro no relatório, mas deixou passar porque era a primeira vez.

examples.en_text: That was a great job opportunity and I let it slip away.
examples.target_text: Aquela era uma ótima oportunidade de emprego e eu a deixei passar.

examples.en_text: She made an unpleasant comment, but I decided to let it slide to avoid a fight.
examples.target_text: Ela fez um comentário desagradável, mas eu decidi deixar passar para evitar uma briga.

examples.en_text: We can't let this chance to travel at the end of the year slip away.
examples.target_text: Nós não podemos deixar passar essa chance de viajar no final do ano.

examples.en_text: They made some mistakes in the project, but the client let it slide.
examples.target_text: Eles cometeram algumas falhas no projeto, mas o cliente deixou passar.

examples.en_text: Did you really let that absurd mistake slide without saying anything?
examples.target_text: Você realmente deixou passar aquele erro absurdo sem falar nada?

explanation_en: Equivalent to 'one of two things' or 'either... or...'. It is used to present a situation where only two logical outcomes or explanations are possible, making it a great transition phrase for structuring arguments.

examples.en_text: One of two things: either you accept the promotion and stay at the company, or you look for another job.
examples.target_text: De duas uma: ou aceitas a promoção e ficas na empresa, ou procuras outro emprego.

examples.en_text: One of two things: either we take the umbrella now, or we are going to get completely wet later.
examples.target_text: De duas uma: ou levamos o guarda-chuva agora, ou vamos ficar completamente molhados mais tarde.

examples.en_text: One of two things: either he lost his phone, or he simply doesn't want to answer my messages.
examples.target_text: De duas uma: ou ele perdeu o telefone, ou simplesmente não quer responder às minhas mensagens.

examples.en_text: One of two things: either we buy the used car, or we continue to use public transportation.
examples.target_text: De duas uma: ou compramos o carro usado, ou continuamos a usar os transportes públicos.

examples.en_text: One of two things: either you start exercising, or you will continue to have back pain.
examples.target_text: De duas uma: ou começas a fazer exercício, ou vais continuar a ter dores nas costas.

examples.en_text: One of two things: either you study hard for the test this weekend, or you are going to fail the course.
examples.target_text: De duas uma: ou estudas a sério para o teste este fim de semana, ou vais reprovar na disciplina.

explanation_en: An old-fashioned but still widely understood idiom meaning to make a scene, draw loud attention to oneself, or act in a showy, disruptive manner.

examples.en_text: There's no need to make a scene over this, it was just a misunderstanding.
examples.target_text: Não precisa tocar bumbo por causa disso, foi só um mal-entendido.

examples.en_text: If the service continues to be bad, I'm going to make a scene and demand my money back.
examples.target_text: Se o serviço continuar ruim, eu vou tocar bumbo e exigir meu dinheiro de volta.

examples.en_text: She always makes a scene when her boyfriend is five minutes late.
examples.target_text: Ela sempre toca bumbo quando o namorado se atrasa cinco minutos.

examples.en_text: The customer started making a scene at the hotel reception because the room wasn't ready.
examples.target_text: O cliente começou a tocar bumbo na recepção do hotel porque o quarto não estava pronto.

examples.en_text: I prefer to resolve things by talking, without needing to make a scene.
examples.target_text: Eu prefiro resolver as coisas conversando, sem precisar tocar bumbo.

examples.en_text: He made a scene at the meeting because he didn't agree with the new rules.
examples.target_text: Ele tocou bumbo na reunião porque não concordou com as novas regras.

explanation_en: A very common expression used to express extreme frustration, exhaustion, or impatience with a situation or person. It is used in daily speech to signal that one has reached their limit.

examples.en_text: I've been working for ten hours straight and I can't take it anymore.
examples.target_text: Estou trabalhando há dez horas seguidas e já não aguento mais.

examples.en_text: The upstairs neighbor is making noise and I can't stand it anymore.
examples.target_text: O vizinho de cima está fazendo barulho e eu não aguento mais.

examples.en_text: It's so hot today that I can't stand staying indoors anymore.
examples.target_text: Está tanto calor hoje que eu já não aguento mais ficar dentro de casa.

examples.en_text: She complains about everything and he says he can't take this situation anymore.
examples.target_text: Ela reclama de tudo e ele diz que não aguenta mais essa situação.

examples.en_text: We can't stand facing this traffic every day to go to work anymore.
examples.target_text: Nós não aguentamos mais pegar esse trânsito todos os dias para ir ao trabalho.

examples.en_text: Please, make up your mind quickly, because I can't stand waiting anymore.
examples.target_text: Por favor, decida logo, porque eu não aguento mais esperar.

explanation_en: This adverbial locution means 'here and there' or 'occasionally.' It is used to describe things occurring in scattered places or at irregular intervals. It is a natural, common way to avoid repeating 'às vezes' or 'em alguns lugares.'

examples.en_text: During the trip, we took a few photos here and there, but we preferred to enjoy the moment.
examples.target_text: Durante a viagem, tirámos algumas fotos aqui e ali, mas preferimos aproveitar o momento.

examples.en_text: The report is very good, you just need to correct a small mistake here and there.
examples.target_text: O relatório está muito bom, só precisa de corrigir um pequeno erro aqui e ali.

examples.en_text: The sky was almost completely blue, with just a few clouds here and there.
examples.target_text: O céu estava quase todo azul, com apenas algumas nuvens aqui e ali.

examples.en_text: I still have a few moving boxes scattered here and there around the house.
examples.target_text: Ainda tenho algumas caixas de mudança espalhadas aqui e ali pela casa.

examples.en_text: At the party yesterday, I saw a few familiar faces here and there.
examples.target_text: Na festa de ontem, vi algumas caras conhecidas aqui e ali.

examples.en_text: I usually eat sweets only here and there, not every day.
examples.target_text: Eu costumo comer doces apenas aqui e ali, não todos os dias.

explanation_en: Literally 'to buy a fight,' this common colloquial expression means to take on a conflict, challenge, or dispute, often on behalf of someone else or for a specific cause. It's widely used in political and everyday contexts to describe someone willingly entering a controversial situation.

examples.en_text: I didn't want to get involved, but I decided to pick this fight to help my friend.
examples.target_text: Eu não queria me envolver, mas decidi comprar essa briga para ajudar meu amigo.

examples.en_text: If you talk to the boss about the schedule, I'll take on this fight with you.
examples.target_text: Se você falar com o chefe sobre o horário, eu compro essa briga com você.

examples.en_text: I don't think it's worth picking this fight right now; it's better to let it go.
examples.target_text: Eu não acho que vale a pena comprar essa briga agora; é melhor deixar para lá.

examples.en_text: The neighborhood association took on this fight against the construction of the new building.
examples.target_text: A associação de moradores comprou essa briga contra a construção do novo prédio.

examples.en_text: Are you sure you want to pick this fight with the marketing team?
examples.target_text: Você tem certeza de que quer comprar essa briga com a equipe de marketing?

examples.en_text: She already has too many problems and is not going to pick this fight over something silly.
examples.target_text: Ela já tem problemas demais e não vai comprar essa briga por causa de uma bobagem.

explanation_en: This idiomatic expression literally means 'to paint and embroider.' It is used to describe someone who does whatever they want, often taking advantage of a situation, behaving without limits, or making a mess because no one is stopping them. It has a highly informal, slightly critical tone.

examples.en_text: When their parents traveled, the kids did whatever they pleased at home.
examples.target_text: Quando os pais viajaram, as crianças pintaram e bordaram em casa.

examples.en_text: Without the boss's supervision, the new employee did whatever he pleased in the office.
examples.target_text: Sem a supervisão do chefe, o novo funcionário pintou e bordou no escritório.

examples.en_text: We left the dog alone and he had a field day with the living room cushions.
examples.target_text: Deixamos o cachorro sozinho e ele pintou e bordou com as almofadas da sala.

examples.en_text: In my youth, I did whatever I pleased, but now I am much calmer.
examples.target_text: Na minha juventude, eu pintei e bordei, mas agora sou bem mais calmo.

examples.en_text: She did whatever she pleased at the wedding party and then left without saying goodbye.
examples.target_text: Ela pintou e bordou na festa de casamento e depois foi embora sem se despedir.

examples.en_text: The striker from the other team did whatever he pleased in our penalty box and scored three goals.
examples.target_text: O atacante do outro time pintou e bordou na nossa área e fez três gols.

explanation_en: This fixed expression is used to demand agreement or to introduce an undeniable, often harsh truth. It translates roughly to 'let's be honest,' 'let's face it,' or 'truth be told.' It is conversational but very common in opinion pieces and political discussions.

examples.en_text: Let's be honest, that report was full of mistakes.
examples.target_text: Vamos e convenhamos, aquele relatório estava cheio de erros.

examples.en_text: The trip was nice, but let's face it, the hotel was horrible.
examples.target_text: A viagem foi legal, mas, vamos e convenhamos, o hotel era horrível.

examples.en_text: The food at that restaurant is good, but let's be honest, it's too expensive.
examples.target_text: A comida daquele restaurante é boa, mas, vamos e convenhamos, é cara demais.

examples.en_text: He speaks well, but let's face it, he knows nothing about the subject.
examples.target_text: Ele fala bem, mas, vamos e convenhamos, ele não sabe nada sobre o assunto.

examples.en_text: The movie has amazing visual effects, but let's be honest, the story is very weak.
examples.target_text: O filme tem efeitos visuais incríveis, mas, vamos e convenhamos, a história é muito fraca.

examples.en_text: Our team played very poorly today, let's be honest.
examples.target_text: Nosso time jogou muito mal hoje, vamos e convenhamos.

explanation_en: A very common colloquial verb meaning 'to get screwed,' 'to fail,' or 'to end up in a bad situation.' While informal, it is not considered highly vulgar, making it extremely common in everyday spoken Portuguese when discussing bad luck or systemic failure.

examples.en_text: People who don't plan for the future always get screwed in the end.
examples.target_text: As pessoas que não planejam o futuro sempre se ferram no final.

examples.en_text: He didn't study for yesterday's exam and got completely screwed.
examples.target_text: Ele não estudou para a prova de ontem e se ferrou completamente.

examples.en_text: I bought that cheap cell phone, but it broke in a week and I got screwed.
examples.target_text: Comprei aquele celular barato, mas ele quebrou em uma semana e eu me ferrei.

examples.en_text: Be careful with this contract so you don't get screwed later.
examples.target_text: Tome cuidado com esse contrato para que você não se ferre depois.

examples.en_text: We forgot the umbrella and got screwed by that storm.
examples.target_text: Nós esquecemos o guarda-chuva e nos ferramos com aquela tempestade.

examples.en_text: If you keep leaving everything to the last minute, you're going to end up getting screwed.
examples.target_text: Se você continuar deixando tudo para a última hora, vai acabar se ferrando.

explanation_en: A common colloquial expression borrowed from English ('to spoil' / 'spoiler'). It means to reveal plot points or, more broadly, to give away a surprise or outcome before someone experiences it. It is widely used in casual speech, especially in media, gaming, and pop culture contexts.

examples.en_text: Please don't give me the spoiler for the end of the movie, I haven't watched it yet.
examples.target_text: Por favor, não me dê o spoiler do final do filme, eu ainda não assisti.

examples.en_text: My sister ended up giving the spoiler by accident and ruined the surprise of the book.
examples.target_text: A minha irmã acabou por dar o spoiler sem querer e estragou a surpresa do livro.

examples.en_text: I want to talk about the series, but I don't want to give a spoiler to those who haven't finished.
examples.target_text: Eu quero falar sobre a série, mas não quero dar o spoiler para quem não terminou.

examples.en_text: If you have already seen the new episode, please don't give the spoiler on social media.
examples.target_text: Se você já viu o novo episódio, por favor, não dê o spoiler nas redes sociais.

examples.en_text: Do you want me to tell you what happens or do you prefer that I don't give the spoiler?
examples.target_text: Você quer que eu conte o que acontece ou prefere que eu não dê o spoiler?

examples.en_text: That film critic gave the spoiler of the whole story in his article.
examples.target_text: Aquele crítico de cinema deu o spoiler de toda a história no artigo dele.

explanation_en: A very common temporal expression meaning 'just a moment ago' or 'a short while ago.' It combines the adverb 'agora' with the verb 'haver' (indicating elapsed time) and 'pouco' (a little). It is essential for natural-sounding conversational Portuguese when referring to the immediate past.

examples.en_text: I tried to call you a short while ago, but your phone was turned off.
examples.target_text: Eu tentei te ligar agora há pouco, mas o seu telefone estava desligado.

examples.en_text: The boss left the room a short while ago, I think he went to have lunch.
examples.target_text: O chefe saiu da sala agora há pouco, acho que ele foi almoçar.

examples.en_text: My keys were here on the table a short while ago, I don't know where I put them.
examples.target_text: Minhas chaves estavam aqui na mesa agora há pouco, não sei onde as coloquei.

examples.en_text: It started raining a short while ago, it's a good thing I brought the umbrella.
examples.target_text: Começou a chover agora há pouco, ainda bem que eu trouxe o guarda-chuva.

examples.en_text: We met a short while ago at the party, but it feels like we've been friends for years.
examples.target_text: Nós nos conhecemos agora há pouco na festa, mas parece que já somos amigos há anos.

examples.en_text: I received the confirmation email a short while ago, I'm going to read the instructions carefully.
examples.target_text: Eu recebi o e-mail de confirmação agora há pouco, vou ler as instruções com calma.

explanation_en: A colloquial expression meaning 'all the time,' 'constantly,' or 'every hour.' It is used to emphasize that an action happens repeatedly and frequently. While grammatically singular, it functions as a plural adverbial phrase of frequency.

examples.en_text: My phone vibrates all the time because of social media.
examples.target_text: Meu celular vibra toda hora por causa das redes sociais.

examples.en_text: At this time of year, it rains all the time in the afternoon.
examples.target_text: Nesta época do ano, chove toda hora à tarde.

examples.en_text: I lose my keys all the time, I need to be more organized.
examples.target_text: Eu perco minhas chaves toda hora, preciso ser mais organizado.

examples.en_text: I can't concentrate if you interrupt me all the time.
examples.target_text: Não consigo me concentrar se você me interromper toda hora.

examples.en_text: She changes her mind all the time, it's hard to plan something with her.
examples.target_text: Ela muda de opinião toda hora, é difícil planejar algo com ela.

examples.en_text: Buses pass all the time on this avenue, you don't need to worry.
examples.target_text: Os ônibus passam toda hora nesta avenida, não precisa se preocupar.
